title: Cyclotron relevance decisions for reference candidates
description: Put a cyclotron at the reference intake gate. For each pending Reference (the item), the relevance cyclotron makes a decision, include or exclude, with a confidence: is this candidate relevant to this publication, given its doctrine? Editors review it in the References tab with thumbs up or down, a reason and an explanation; the cyclotron aligns to that feedback. A status strip shows what the cyclotron is doing, including the review rate and why. Papyrus is also the public example for the Cyclotron marketing site. Engine design and engine epic: AnthusAI/Cyclotron project/wiki/papyrus-integration.md (branch docs/papyrus-integration), epic decision-flywheel-a73f05cc. Local summary: project/wiki/cyclotron-integration.md. Phase one never accepts a Reference without a person. Order: configuration, data model, pipeline hook, then rating UI and status strip, then the marketing recording.
right_now_summary: The relevance sweep and review UI are built, but a live sandbox smoke test still remains.
